finding.text: The demo is meant to show "one part of each of the six types", but only three blocks say which type they are. The part-link card shows its target's title ("ITEM README, AS PARTS") instead of the `title: "part-link"` the line gives it, and the part-file block has no label at all (page 8) — shots/…-parts-types/1920.png, middle band.

The `t-live` card is now a permanent line in `types/page.jsonl`, yet it says "This line was appended after the page loaded". That stops being true for anyone who opens the page later (content 11) — shots/…-parts-types/1920.png, last card.
`Meter.js` sets the bar's width, height and background as inline styles. The height and the background are static, so they belong in a class or token; only the width needs to be inline (layout 42).
The Parts page reaches the new Part types page only through the sidebar. Its own content has no link or part-link to `types/` (content 8) — shots/…-parts/sheet.png.
PageView and PageFile are new classes with no page that lists their live instances. They hold no state worth watching, so this is only a note (rules: show the class).
